title: Distinct designated tape indices
statement: For natural numbers $m,c$ with $0<c$, the assignment of four designated tape indices into the host tape set of size $(m+2)+(1+c)+1$ is injective. The indices are the two specified source-bank positions, the final host position, and the call-bank position corresponding to the first virtual bank tape.
